author_note: Independently authored minimal-pair test data, written without seeing the checker code. Labels reflect what a careful human reader would take each line to claim. Group 'zero' separates 'zero' as a quantity of experience (negation) from 'zero' as an achieved outcome while using the skill (affirmation). Group 'backref' has a later short negative sentence that points back to an earlier skill (negation), or a later negative sentence about something unrelated (skill stays affirmed). No real people's data.
